integrity: Finite composition enumeration corroborates all tested rank-height coefficients, not infinite-case proof. Probabilistic limit uses the self-contained factorial-moment argument.
scientific_limitations: Only order-preserving partial isometries; Poisson limit for uniformly sampled nilpotents along lattice subsequences. Total nilpotent enumeration and classical Bernoulli longest-run limit are prior work. Earlier 2014/2016 source full texts were not completely inspected.
title: Nilpotency-height rank profiles and a lattice extreme law for order-preserving partial isometries
